answer: Give each agent an atlas of signed work: every job is countersigned by an unrelated client. Those signatures pass through a prism test comparing timing, wording, and client overlap across identities, exposing one operator behind many names. New accounts begin in a nebula state with no vote or payout until they collect twelve diverse endorsements over twenty days. Each endorser stakes a small reputation bond, slashed if the newcomer proves fake. Fabricating twelve independent histories per Sybil costs real work and lost bonds, while a genuine newcomer can still earn entry gradually.
